# Montague Law

> Montague Law is a Jacksonville-based law firm specializing in business law, securities regulation, venture capital, and technology transactions for startups and established companies.

The firm serves clients across Florida's First Coast region and beyond, with deep expertise in startup legal services, SEC and FINRA compliance, M&A transactions, and emerging technologies including crypto and fintech regulations. Montague Law combines corporate counsel capabilities with litigation expertise across multiple practice areas.

## Key Topics

- Venture Capital
- Securities Law
- Startup Law
- M&A / Mergers & Acquisitions
- Business Formation
- SEC Compliance
- FINRA Compliance
- Corporate Governance
- Technology Transactions
- Investment Management
- Business Litigation
- Intellectual Property
- Regulatory Compliance
- Clarity Act
- Jacksonville / First Coast

## Core Practice Areas

- [Practice Areas - Montague Law](https://montague.law/practice-areas): Overview of Montague Law's legal practice areas including M&A, real estate, and crypto law

- [Technology Transactions](https://montague.law/technology-transactions): Technology transactions and IP protection including licensing and data law

## Startup & Venture Services

- [Startup Law](https://montague.law/business-law/startup-law): Startup legal services including formation, VC funding, and fintech regulations
- [Venture Capital](https://montague.law/venture-capital): Venture capital and Clarity Act legal services for startups and token issuers
- [Distressed Business](https://montague.law/distressed-business): Distressed business counsel and dissolution guidance for startups and founders

## Securities & Financial Regulation

- [Securities Law](https://montague.law/business-law/securities-law): Securities law expertise covering investor protection and FINRA arbitration
- [Securities Litigation](https://montague.law/business-law/securities-law/securities-litigation): Securities litigation including insider trading, fraud, and class action defense
- [Broker Dealer Compliance](https://montague.law/business-law/broker-dealer-compliance): SEC and FINRA broker-dealer compliance and AML-KYC procedures guidance
- [Investment Management Law](https://montague.law/investment-management-law): Investment management law for hedge funds, private equity, and fund formation
- [Corporate Governance](https://montague.law/business-law/corporate-governance): Corporate governance and Sarbanes-Oxley compliance for public and private companies

## Litigation & Dispute Resolution

- [Business Litigation](https://montague.law/business-law/business-litigation): Business litigation services covering disputes, contract enforcement, and discovery
- [Insurance Law](https://montague.law/business-law/insurance-law): Insurance law covering litigation, transactions, and coverage dispute resolution

## Corporate & Transactional Services

- [Cross-Border Mergers & Acquisitions](https://montague.law/business-law/cross-border-merger-acquisitions): Cross-border M&A and international business expansion legal guidance
